payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the pretrained word embeddings used, including GloVe embeddings and Edinburgh embeddings, as well as emoji embeddings derived from emoji descriptions.

claims.text: 200-dimensional GloVe embeddings trained on 2 Billion tweets are integrated into the system.
Edinburgh embeddings are obtained by training a skip-gram model on the Edinburgh corpus.
Emoji embeddings learned from emoji descriptions are used to enhance the representation of tweets.
